transcript.text: Roomba i7 keeps stopping and saying Error 2. App says something about the brushes. We have a long haired dog.

Please switch off and unplug your vacuum, or remove the battery, for safety. Turn the floorhead over and cut away any hair or thread wrapped around the brush bar and at the end caps. Many bars slide out using a coin-slot catch. Once clear, check that it turns freely by hand. Was it tangled or jammed (and is it clear now), is the bar or an end cap broken, or was it clean and turning freely?

Took the rubber brushes out and pulled off the yellow end caps. There was thick hair wound round the axle underneath, so it was tangled. I've cut it all away and cleaned the caps, then put it back together. Nothing looks broken.
Thanks for confirming that. Please switch on the vacuum with the head tilted so you can see the bar. Is the brush bar spinning now, or still not?
Tested it on the kitchen floor first and it runs fine. There was also a hair tie stuck in the frame which I pulled out. Tried the living room rug after and no error now, brushes are turning.

[Heading: Hair or thread jamming the brush bar]
Thanks for letting us know about your I7 robot vacuum. It’s good to hear it is spinning normally again, which suggests that hair or thread had jammed the brush bar. Since you have cleared this obstruction, no replacement parts are needed. The issue should now be fully resolved.
